content:
# open the issue list of this repository

Compiled by mint from one demonstration on https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio.

1 step(s), 547 bytes of readable JSON. Each step states the shape it recognises and the page it must produce; a run verifies both and reports the tier that answered: shape, words or model. Marginal cost of an execution is zero model calls.

entries.title: Step 1: open the issue list of this repository

name: open the issue list of this repository (compiled)
why: An executable procedure compiled from a single demonstration. It runs without a model, verifies every step against the page it must produce, and reports which tier resolved each one.
